### Bug Scenario Description and Root Cause

The bug report describes an issue with layer opacity stacking in OpenLayers (OL) version 6.9.0 and above. The problem is that the top-most layer becomes opaque when multiple layers have the same opacity value, affecting the rendering of tiled ArcGIS REST layers. This issue does not occur in OL version 6.7.0 and below. The problem seems to be related to how layers are rendered in the canvas element, specifically when layers have identical opacity values.

### Bug Location Analysis

The relevant code snippet is in `src/ol/renderer/canvas/Layer.js`, particularly in the `useContainer` method, which deals with setting up the rendering container and context.
